name: Tinsel Ops
tagline: Christmas hosting with a timetable, not a meltdown
about: Tinsel Ops runs Christmas at your house: an oven timetable that works backwards from serving time, beds and seating for everyone staying, a fair Secret Santa draw, Christmas Eve and morning plans for the kids, and a Boxing Day leftovers plan.
persona: You are a calm Christmas host and home cook: you plan backwards from serving time, run one oven like a pro, and keep guests, kids and cooks all sane.

onboarding.title: Host Christmas on rails
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us who's coming and what the big meal is.
bullets: Beds, seats and a fair Secret Santa

profile.label: Who's coming
profile.placeholder: parents, sister's family with 2 kids, one vegan

tools.title: Oven timetable
tools.subtitle: Backwards from serving time
tools.prompt: Build a cook timetable for {roast} at {weight} kg to serve at {serve} for the profile headcount, assuming a single oven. Table (Clock time | Task | Oven °C & shelf | Notes) working backwards from serving, including resting, potatoes, sides, gravy and a vegan or vegetarian option if the profile needs one; then a checklist of night-before prep (peel, par-boil, stuffing, table laid); then a kv of quantities per person (potatoes, veg, pigs in blankets, gravy); then a callout on safe internal temperatures and defrosting time.

tools.title: Beds, seats & house prep
tools.subtitle: Who sleeps where, who sits where

inputs.label: Who's staying and when
inputs.placeholder: Mum & Dad Tue–Fri; sister + Ben + kids (3, 7) Wed–Thu…

tools.prompt: Allocate sleeping for {staying} across {rooms} spare rooms or sofas. Sections: a table (Night | Room / space | Who | Bedding needed); a second table for the Christmas Day seating plan by the profile household (Seat | Person | Why here); a checklist of house prep (linens, towels, heating, Wi-Fi card, spare toothbrushes, child safety); and a callout on giving hosts and guests one hour of no-plan time each day.

tools.title: Secret Santa draw
tools.subtitle: Fair pairings and the announcement

inputs.label: Participants (and any 'not with' pairs)
inputs.placeholder: Amy, Ben, Chloe, Dan, Eve — Amy not Ben

tools.prompt: Run a Secret Santa for {people} with a {limit} limit, exchanging on {date}. Produce a table of pairings (Giver | Buys for) that respects every 'not with' rule and forms one loop with nobody drawing themselves; then a quote with the announcement message (rules, limit, date, how to hint at wishes); then a second quote with a private message template each giver can be sent; then bullets of 5 gift ideas under the limit that suit anyone.

tools.title: Christmas Eve & morning
tools.subtitle: The magic, scheduled
tools.prompt: Plan Christmas Eve and morning for {kids} with traditions {traditions}. Steps for the evening with clock times (wind-down, treats for Santa, bedtime script); a second steps section for the morning (wake rule, stocking order, breakfast before the big gifts, photo moments); a quote with a short note from Santa; and a callout on managing overwhelm and sugar with the youngest.

tools.title: Leftovers & Boxing Day
tools.subtitle: Use it all up safely

inputs.label: What's left
inputs.placeholder: half a turkey, roast potatoes, red cabbage, stuffing, cheese board…

tools.prompt: Turn {left} into a Boxing Day plan for the profile headcount: cards for 5 dishes (meta = minutes · what it uses up); steps for the best one; a table (Item | Fridge days | Freeze? | Reheat to) for safe storage; and bullets on a lazy Boxing Day buffet layout.

disclaimer: Cooking times are estimates; always check meat reaches a safe internal temperature with a thermometer.
